chapter: Songwriting and the future of New Orleans music
title: Where New Orleans music stands now and what producers decide
summary: King argues New Orleans music is marketable, recalls Motown dissecting New Orleans tracks, and criticizes producers deciding what the public will buy.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship
